notes: Needs ruling (rule 11): the quoted source is named only by its title «رجال الكشي», so the chain is read as written and its source is left to the archive
«غير واحد» is a phrase for unnamed transmitters, so unnamed; the Imam is named after «عن» in the chain, so an ordinary narrator; «عليه السلام» is an honorific
«[2/229]» and «رجال الكشي:» are the Muʿjam's citation labels, not links; the Imam's words are the saying
